mechanism.claim: When a completed high-variation eight-hour BTC block's endpoint return has the opposite sign from the median of its 96 completed five-minute returns, a minority of large jumps has displaced the close against broad interval drift. Trade with the median return breadth for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the median 5m open-to-close log return, opposite the strict block return sign
mechanism.why_distinct: Jump-reversal candidates measure bipower residual magnitude, sign-run and entropy candidates measure ordering or concentration, and range candidates use extrema. HVMBC uses the robust cross-sectional median direction versus endpoint direction, no prior event set or diagnostic control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed-block realized-variation causal rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: conditional 00:05/08:05/16:05 UTC median-breadth contradiction clocks are absent from Gross9

features.block: 96 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute aggregates in [D-8h,D), each from five unique 1m rows
features.breadth_return: median of all 96 finite bar returns, strict nonzero
features.contradiction: breadth and block returns have opposite strict signs
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared 5m bar returns), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 252; current excluded

clock.decision: exact block boundary after all source bars complete
clock.reservation: fixed blocks and holds nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all stages

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block, median, contradiction, rank, history, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
